title: Mount Siguniang Is 6,250 m — and Altitude Hits You Long Before the Top | China Travel Expert
description:
Mount Siguniang's main peak is 6,250 m — but the altitude catches tourists far lower, in the valleys everyone treats as an easy stroll.

Mount Siguniang (四姑娘山, "Four Sisters Mountain") in western Sichuan is a wall of four snow peaks, nicknamed the "Queen of Sichuan." Almost no one climbs the highest sister, Yaomei Feng (6,250 m). Most visitors walk the three valleys instead — and that's the catch: the base town of Rilong already sits around 3,200 m, and trekking toward Dafeng puts your camp near 4,300 m. Go up too fast and altitude sickness, not the terrain, is what ends the trip.

🧭 Expert Tip: sleep a night in Rilong (≈3,200 m) and take the easy Shuangqiao valley bus tour first — let your body acclimatize before any real trekking.

四姑娘山幺妹峰6250米，游客其实很少登顶；真正的风险是山谷——日隆镇就已经3200米，往大峰扎营接近4300米，上得太快高原反应才是麻烦。
